solutionSearchEvidence: Existing battle-2v2-reconnect-core is the authority for local seat controlMode/controlGeneration and exposes isCurrent2v2ControlEnvelope; no duplicate reconnect state is needed.
Existing recovery presentation core and runtime surface already own READY/WAITING/RECONNECTING/STALE presentation and input-lock projection; this adapter must not recreate those semantics.
SELF can map to READY and TEMPORARY_PARTNER to WAITING for the explicitly identified local human seat; PERMANENT_PARTNER and UNCONTROLLED are not guessed and must fail closed.

RECONNECTING is allowed only from caller-explicit reconnectInFlight while the local seat is TEMPORARY_PARTNER; the reconnect core has no intermediate in-flight state, so the adapter never invents one.

STALE_INPUT_REJECTED is allowed only when caller explicitly identifies a control-envelope rejection and the existing current-envelope guard proves a well-formed local-seat envelope is no longer current.
browser/GAMEROAD.html, deploy build, SlidePad, Battle screen and gameplay/network authorities are concurrently owned elsewhere and remain READ_ONLY.
